verdict.rationale: Independent community users repeatedly describe Better Auth as open source, and one commenter's judgment of its 'codebase' implies the source is publicly readable. However, no first-party evidence names the license or links the source repository. Another commenter notes some features are enterprise-only, so the whole product may not be openly licensed. Missing for 10: first-party statement of the specific open-source license, documented public source repository, clarity on whether enterprise-only features are also open-licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: We have been using better-auth (open source) for a while
